description.en: Run your freelance business: clients and follow-ups, quotes and invoices, prospecting, admin.
description.fr: Gérez votre activité freelance : clients et relances, devis et factures, prospection, admin.

crons.name: Follow-ups due
crons.prompt: Read the client files in this topic folder and list the follow-ups due today or overdue (field 'Next follow-up' and the history), plus clients with no contact for longer than the rhythm set in the topic memory. One line per client: who, why, suggested next step. Do not send anything. If there are no client files yet, report it in one line and stop.

crons.name: Unpaid invoices
crons.prompt: Check invoices/index.md in this topic folder: list the invoices that are unpaid and past their due date (number, client, amount, days late) and the ones due this week, with the total outstanding. Suggest a reminder for each late one but draft nothing and send nothing. If the invoice index is missing, report it in one line and stop.
